messages:
alex: FYI — saw a diff on Argo for the gpu-pool chart during the prod rollout. Argo says 'rendered manifests differ' and the CRD's nodeSelector/tolerations became `null` in prod which trips the values schema.
maria: ugh. do we have a helm template output from the failing sync?
alex: i grabbed the `helm template` output for prod values. snippet: 
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
spec:
  tolerations: null
  nodeSelector: null
```

sam: that usually means a helper returned nil or we merged with an empty value. which helper are we using for defaults?
alex: _helpers.tpl has this helper: 
```
{{- define "gpu.nodeSelector" -}}
{{- $base := .Values.nodeSelector -}}
{{- $defaults := .Values.nodeSelectorDefaults -}}
{{- merge $base $defaults | toYaml | nindent 2 -}}
{{- end -}}
```

alex: merge returns null when $base is nil and $defaults is missing, so `toYaml` prints `null`. values.schema.json expects an object/array and Argo flags it.
maria: ok — helm's `merge` can be finicky. coalesce or `default` is safer.
sam: quick patch: use coalesce to ensure an empty dict if both missing. e.g. 
```
{{- $ns := coalesce (dict) .Values.nodeSelector .Values.nodeSelectorDefaults -}}
{{- $ns | toYaml | nindent 2 -}}
```

tia: +1. also for tolerations and affinities do the same. We should standardize a small helper `safeMap` in _helpers.tpl and use everywhere.
maria: note for CI — `helm lint` doesn't catch this because it checks templates statically. we need to run `helm template` with our value matrix (staging/prod/minimal) in chart-testing job so we catch `null` renders.
sam: agreed. propose adding a new ct test step: `helm template ./charts/gpu-pool -f ci/values/minimal.yaml` and fail on 'null' occurrences or schema mismatch.
alex: I'll open a quick PR with the helper + fix + CI step. tagging @tia for review.
tia: small note — prod values currently have region-specific node selectors (us-west uses gpu: a100, eu-west a40). Make sure the safeMap merge doesn't accidentally swallow region keys; test both regions in CI. Also check cost team: we don't want accidental fallback to cheaper gpu in prod.
maria: good call. i'll add a matrix for regions to the template test.
sam: ops procedural: once PR is up, we'll do a canary sync in Argo (one namespace) then promote. deploy-bot will post status.
deploy-bot: (automated) PR #5234 created by alex: 'fix(gpu-pool): coalesce nodeSelector/tolerations and add helm template CI test' — checks: ct/lint queued.
alex: thanks. quick mitigation if anyone hits the same diff before PR merges: add an explicit `{}` for nodeSelector/tolerations in prod values.yaml as a workaround. but that's brittle.
tia: can we also add a lint rule to our chart-linting repo that flags `toYaml` outputs of `null`? small grep is fine for now.
maria: yeah i'll add that as a follow-up ticket and include the grep in the ct job: `helm template ... | grep -n "\bnull\b" && exit 1`
sam: sounds good. thanks for the fast triage.
alex: np — PR up in 10m. will include test cases for us-west/eu-west/minimal.
maria: cc product & cost: FYI, this was a template rendering issue not a real node drift. no cost changes expected.
tia: closing loop: after merge i'll run an ad-hoc `helm template` across all clusters and post results here. :thumbsup:
